policy: The test split is scored once per FINAL model configuration; validation alone selects hyperparameters (hybrid blend weight w, smoothed-seismicity sigma). Re-runs of an identical, deterministic (random_state=42) configuration are reproduction / artifact regeneration, NOT new model selection, and are logged here for auditability. Any future test scoring for a NEW or RE-TUNED model family must be appended with an honest purpose.

model_families.hybrid+baselines: HistGradientBoostingRegressor(poisson) blended with the cascade ETAS simulation; baselines = cascade, firstgen_etas, smoothed, poisson, fault_prox. w and sigma chosen on VAL only.

touches.result: y35 test PR-AUC cascade 0.13004 / firstgen 0.12597 / hybrid 0.11737; w=0.7.
